_about: Behavior profile: the bridge between Seek and the robots. Distances are in BODY LENGTHS, speeds in BODY LENGTHS PER SECOND, so the same profile can describe a microbe or a robot. Later, Seek will fit these numbers from real trajectories; for now they are hand-picked Couzin-model values.
source: hand-tuned placeholder (not yet fitted from Seek data)

override._about: Intervene phase: a human command overrides the swarm rules. We measure how long it takes the group to reach the target, then release control and watch whether the swarm re-forms on its own.
